forms.label: Whole, raw
forms.sourceNote: FoodData Central carries no record for Prunus padus, the small, astringent bird cherry a Russian kompot is traditionally boiled from. Cherries, sour, red, raw (public domain) is adopted as the closest available proxy: the same genus, a comparably tart stone fruit of similar size. No density is stated: the fruit is boiled and its solids strained or left in the pot rather than poured.
